facts.text: Deborah and Anna were sitting by the sea, watching the sunset and talking about each other on 22 March 2023.

evidence.quote: Recently, Anna and I were sitting by the sea, watching the sunset and talking about each other.

facts.text: Jolene mentioned she wants to learn to surf and needs to find spare time to do so.

facts.text: Jolene has been gathering information, watching videos, and obtained a beginners' guide to surfing.

facts.text: Jolene expressed that she is motivated to try surfing and will keep pushing herself to achieve it.
